name: Yudai Sayashi
source:
The story's protagonist and leader of Durchhalten. He is street smart and charismatic, having had to learn how to survive the hard way after he and his sister were abandoned when they were young. He struggles to reconcile his acquired distrust towards other people with his desire to lend a hand. He's willing to take extreme measures in order to bring his sister back from the dead.

[From [url=http://exogenesisvn.com/characters/]the official website[/url]]
